title: Giving Magnus 1 Extra Rook Until I LOSE
summary: Reverse-odds series 'Giving X 1 extra piece until I lose' vs the Magnus bot (2882): the creator (White, ~2207) keeps his normal army while Magnus (Black) gets extra rooks, one more after every win, until Magnus beats him. Thumbnail '13 Rooks?' shows rows of black rooks, so the count climbed to roughly 13.
rules: Player (White): standard army. Magnus bot (Black): standard army plus N extra rooks placed on Black's side (ranks 6-5 and beyond as N grows).
Start with 1 extra rook; after each player win add one more rook (title 'Giving Magnus 1 Extra Rook Until I LOSE').
Normal chess rules; series ends at the first loss.
win_condition: Keep checkmating Magnus as his rook count grows; record the count at which you lose (~13 per thumbnail).
